vignette: An infant with a cleft lip is followed by a craniofacial team. The parent asks whether dental visits will still matter after the surgical phase and why a pediatric dentist would join the team.
stem: Which statement best reflects dental care for this child?

options.text: Dental care is needed throughout life, and a pediatric dentist on the team is ideal because exam and restorative timing often differs from standard periodicity.
Dental care is needed only until the surgical phase ends and can be discontinued afterward.
Cleft rehabilitation is brief, so involvement of a specialized team is needed only for a short time.
A standard periodicity schedule is sufficient, so a pediatric dentist on the team adds little.
